3.speaker: Narrator
3.text: I had called a council meeting in Fort Ales to discuss our strategy in the Pales gas dispute.

4.speaker: Narrator
4.text: The city was named after its most famous building, a Valgish fortress that now served as the government headquarters for the Pales Administrative District.

5.speaker: Narrator
5.text: Titus escorted me down the hallway to a nondescript conference room, where Laurento, Lucita, Elena and Hugo were already waiting.

6.speaker: Narrator
6.text: I took a seat across from Lucita.

8.speaker: Hugo Toras
8.text: "Good morning, Your Majesty. Should we fill you in on the situation so far?"

10.speaker: Player_Romus
10.text: "I've read the reports. I know about the Palesian drillship."

11.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
11.text: "Duke Reinhart is now under the impression that the entire gas field belongs to Pales. He has ordered that exploratory drilling begin immediately."

13.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
13.text: "I'll take it from here. As you know, our joint team of researchers recently completed their assessment of the gas field between Pales and Rizia -- tentatively nicknamed Aureus."

14.speaker: Elena Werner
14.text: "However, a few days after our team's return to port, we received the news that the Palesians had made a different decision."

15.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
15.text: "The Rizian surveyors determined that the field lay in both Rizian and Palesian territory."

16.speaker: Elena Werner
16.text: "Then where should we start, Your Majesty?"

17.speaker: Player_Romus
17.text: "Well... why is this a dispute? I thought our maritime borders were clear."

18.speaker: Player_Romus
18.text: "Do we now know how much gas the field contains?"

19.speaker: Player_Romus
19.text: "That's enough information. I'm ready to discuss our response."
19.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn02_PalesCouncil_GasHub_RiziaNeed"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn02_PalesCouncil_GasHub_Discovery"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn02_PalesCouncil_GasHub_FieldSize"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn02_PalesCouncil_GasHub_Borders"] == true

20.speaker: Elena Werner
20.text: "We still don't have exact numbers. But the surveyors have confirmed that it's a lot."

21.speaker: Elena Werner
21.text: "Quite possibly more than the current natural gas reserves of Rizia and Pales combined."

22.speaker: Lucita Azaro
22.text: "In other words, whichever country controls the Aureus field will become Merkopa's next energy superpower."

23.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
23.text: "They've been shifting for the past century."

24.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
24.text: "The late Empire of Valgos used to control the waters between Pales and Caleqabiz. But the area came into question when the island joined Rizia in 1855."

26.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
26.text: "And in case of overlap, no one country may exploit those resources without the other's agreement."

27.speaker: Elena Werner
27.text: "A nation has the sovereign right to any undersea gas and oil wells located within 200 kilometers of its coast."

28.speaker: Player_Romus
28.text: "So it's clear. Pales is breaking the law by claiming sole ownership."

29.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
29.text: "The borders that Rizia recognizes today are the ones defined by the 1942 AN Directive on Offshore Resources. According to those, the field should be split almost exactly evenly between our two nations."

30.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
30.text: "Technically, no. Reinhart's predecessor signed ANDOR, but the Duke has yet to ratify it."

31.speaker: Player_Romus
31.text: "Are both Pales and Rizia signatories of this directive?"

32.speaker: Player_Romus
32.text: "What happens if a country violates that directive?"

33.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
33.text: "Rizia has both signed and ratified ANDOR. Reinhart's predecessor signed the directive, but the Duke has yet to ratify it."

34.speaker: Lucita Azaro
34.text: "They'd be subject to prosecution in an international court. And any military action against them would be fully justified."

35.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
35.text: "Technically, Pales wouldn't be violating ANDOR by drilling without Rizia's consent. Reinhart's predecessor signed the directive, but the Duke has yet to ratify it."

39.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
39.text: "You established a rapport with Duke Reinhart prior to your coronation. Perhaps there's a way to build on that."

43.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
43.text: "I know you and Duke Reinhart don't have much of a rapport. But it might not be too late to come to an understanding."

45.speaker: Player_Romus
45.text: "Can't we just split the field 50-50 with Pales. That's what we have a legal claim to, isn't it?"

46.speaker: Player_Romus
46.text: "What if I were to let Pales keep its claim to the entire field?"

47.speaker: Player_Romus
47.text: "Does Rizia need the gas from the field?"

49.speaker: Elena Werner
49.text: "Yes, that was the outcome I was hoping for before this incident."

50.speaker: Elena Werner
50.text: "But it seems that without the aid of a third party, sharing the field will be more difficult than expected."

53.speaker: Narrator
53.text: The meeting drew to a close.

54.speaker: Narrator
54.text: I spent a sleepless night in Fort Ales, wondering what would happen when the ship from Pales got to its destination.

65.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
65.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn02_PalesCouncil_GasHub_RiziaNeed"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn02_PalesCouncil_GasHub_Discovery"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn02_PalesCouncil_GasHub_FieldSize"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn02_PalesCouncil_GasHub_Borders"] == true

66.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
66.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn02_PalesCouncil_GasHub_RiziaNeed"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn02_PalesCouncil_GasHub_Discovery"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn02_PalesCouncil_GasHub_FieldSize"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn02_PalesCouncil_GasHub_Borders"] == true) == false

79.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
79.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn02_PalesCouncil_DiplomacyHub_ClaimAll"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn02_PalesCouncil_DiplomacyHub_Cede"] == true  or Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn02_PalesCouncil_DiplomacyHub_Share"] == true) == false

80.speaker: Player_Romus
80.text: "I would welcome any other suggestions from my councilors."

81.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
81.text: "The Palesians furthermore state that as a sparsely populated island, Caleqabiz should not have the same maritime radius as mainland Rizia."

85.speaker: Narrator
85.text: She blushed. The other councilors studiously trained their eyes away from us.

86.speaker: Narrator
86.text: She blushed. The other councilors didn't seem to notice.

91.speaker: Narrator
91.text: My daughter had requested to stay home this time around, claiming she was feeling unwell.

99.speaker: Narrator
99.text: The other councilors busied themselves with the documents they were holding. Hugo finally spoke up.

100.speaker: Narrator
100.text: My fellow councilors were all poring over various documents. Hugo finally stood up.

103.speaker: Narrator
103.text: Lucita had a worried look on her face.

104.speaker: Lucita Azaro
104.text: "A Palesian drillship departed the port of Remaz at 0800 this morning. It is expected to reach the field by this time tomorrow."

105.speaker: Lucita Azaro
105.text: "Your Majesty, I have advocated for caution regarding Pales in the past. But this strikes me as highly concerning."

106.speaker: Player_Romus
106.text: "I completely agree, Lucita. We cannot ignore this obvious provocation."

110.speaker: Player_Romus
110.text: "I share those concerns, Duchess. The Palesians were out of line to send that ship."

111.speaker: Player_Romus
111.text: "I still believe that caution is called for. I want to know all the details before we decide on our reaction."

112.speaker: Narrator
112.text: Hugo cast a sidelong glance at my use of Lucita's first name.

113.speaker: Player_Romus
113.text: "I'm sure there is a logical explanation. We shouldn't assume this was an act of aggression."

114.speaker: Hugo Toras
114.text: "A response from Rizia is certainly warranted. I called this meeting today to decide on our course of action."

116.speaker: Hugo Toras
116.text: "I agree, Your Majesty. But we cannot let the act go unremarked upon."

117.speaker: Hugo Toras
117.text: "Provocation or not, it indeed mustn't be ignored. I called this meeting today to decide our course of action."

118.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
118.text: "We have a meeting set with Duke Reinhart in two days. By which time the ship will have reached its destination."

119.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
119.text: "It is my hope that the Palesians are still open to negotiating the field's ownership, and that this is just a tactic to give them an edge."

120.speaker: Elena Werner
120.text: "You're getting ahead of yourself, Laurento. The King should be as informed about this dispute as possible before heading to Pales."

121.speaker: Player_Romus
121.text: "You're right as usual, Ms. Werner. I want to know everything I can about the disputed field."

122.speaker: Player_Romus
122.text: "I'm all caught up on the details. Let's get to the meat of the matter."

123.speaker: Player_Romus
123.text: "That's fair enough. What are we even using Caleqabiz for, anyway?"

124.speaker: Hugo Toras
124.text: "Its strategic location between mainland Merkopa and Kyrute makes it a very useful port and naval base. And we should not forget about the presence of the exiled ex-Duchess Angelica Sazon."

125.speaker: Player_Romus
125.text: "But that's nonsense, right? It wouldn't hold up in an international court."

126.speaker: Elena Werner
126.text: "That's debatable, Your Majesty. With enough legal firepower and international support, Pales could have a case."

127.speaker: Player_Romus
127.text: "How dare they disparage our island? They will pay for their impertinence."

129.speaker: Hugo Toras
129.text: "Caleqabiz may be small, but it holds large strategic importance. It is unfair to call it a lesser part of Rizia."

133.speaker: Elena Werner
133.text: "I'll be blunt, Your Majesty. Our existing gas reserves are dwindling."

134.speaker: Elena Werner
134.text: "The Esqiris field off of Valenqiris is on the verge of shutting down if we do not invest in its expansion."

138.speaker: Elena Werner
138.text: "Our expansion of the Esqiris field will increase gas production, though access to even half of Aureus would yield better results."

143.speaker: Elena Werner
143.text: "President Ewald Alphonso was pleased enough with our trade deal that he has hinted at offering us a stake in his own gas company, Gasom. But next year's Sordish elections may jeopardize that offer."

144.speaker: Elena Werner
144.text: "Although we rejected Sordland's trade deal, President Alphonso has hinted at an opportunity to invest in his own gas company, Gasom, through back channels. But next year's Sordish elections may jeopardize that offer."

145.speaker: Player_Romus
145.text: "Sounds shady. I wouldn't be surprised if this Gasom was on the verge of bankruptcy."

146.speaker: Player_Romus
146.text: "Alphonso's slipping in the polls already, eh? I wonder who the next guy will be."

147.speaker: Player_Romus
147.text: "That sounds promising nonetheless. Follow up that lead if you can."

148.speaker: Player_Romus
148.text: "Just as well. I've had enough dealings with the Sords."

149.speaker: Elena Werner
149.text: "Their gas holdings are quite prodigious. I wouldn't write them off."

150.speaker: Elena Werner
150.text: "It's too early to tell. He could still pull off a win."

151.speaker: Elena Werner
151.text: "Whatever the state of the company, there's no denying that Sordland has prodigious gas holdings."

156.speaker: Elena Werner
156.text: "Outside of gas, our overall energy reserves are healthy."

157.speaker: Elena Werner
157.text: "Sordish or otherwise, we could really use the gas to bolster our overall energy reserves."

164.speaker: Elena Werner
164.text: "And we can't forget about the contract we signed with Rumburg. We are exporting and making good on our energy obligations already."

165.speaker: Elena Werner
165.text: "But we don't know what the future might bring."

166.speaker: Elena Werner
166.text: "We're running low as it is, and we don't know what the future might bring."

168.speaker: Lucita Azaro
168.text: "Actually, I have some additional information that could influence our response."

172.speaker: Elena Werner
172.text: "Given Rizia's current natural gas needs, we should not relinquish our claim on the field without seriously considering the consequences."

173.speaker: Elena Werner
173.text: "Though we do not strictly need the gas from the field, we should not relinquish it without seriously considering the consequences."

178.speaker: Hugo Toras
178.text: "By all means, Duchess Azaro, go on."

179.speaker: Narrator
179.text: She took out a photograph. It showed a number of men in business suits boarding a large vessel.

180.speaker: Lucita Azaro
180.text: "Our intelligence in Pales managed to get a visual on the boat before it departed. This man here is a representative from LesPower, the Lespian energy corporation."

182.speaker: Hugo Toras
182.text: "I was not informed that we had active intelligence operating in Pales."

183.speaker: Lucita Azaro
183.text: "His Majesty and I made the decision to establish it."

184.speaker: Player_Romus
184.text: "You will not question Duchess Azaro's ability to do her job."

185.speaker: Hugo Toras
185.text: "You were involved in this, Your Majesty? I thought the Wehlen investigation took full precedence."

186.speaker: Player_Romus
186.text: "Duchess, I do hope this surveillance didn't pull too much focus away from the Zille investigation."

187.speaker: Lucita Azaro
187.text: "It did not, Your Majesty. I'll remind you that my department has been almost completely uninvolved in the Zille bombing fallout."

188.speaker: Narrator
188.text: Lucita tried to conceal her indignance.

190.speaker: Player_Romus
190.text: "I believed the same. But she convinced me the Pales situation was worth keeping an eye on, and that turned out to be the case."

191.speaker: Player_Romus
191.text: "Actually, I don't understand how this changes anything. We knew Pales and Lespia were in cahoots."

192.speaker: Lucita Azaro
192.text: "What this evidence proves is that it's not Pales alone asserting its claim to the field. Lespia, and by extension ATO, is after that gas and all the money and power that comes with it."

193.speaker: Player_Romus
193.text: "I do find it worrying that Lespia is so heavily involved in this expedition."

194.speaker: Narrator
194.text: Lucita flashed me a grateful smile.

196.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
196.text: "This photo sends a different message to me. Could it be possible that Lespia pressured Pales into claiming the field and sending the ship? And if so, can we use that fact to drive a wedge between the two?"

197.speaker: Lucita Azaro
197.text: "I would humbly ask my fellow councilors to focus on the content of these findings, not the methods used to obtain them."

198.speaker: Hugo Toras
198.text: "Forgive me, both of you. The last thing we need in this council is discord. And Duchess Azaro's findings are concerning to me as well."

199.speaker: Player_Romus
199.text: "Yes, Hugo, don't try to turn me against the Duchess. We're all colleagues here."

205.speaker: Lucita Azaro
205.text: "It did not, Your Majesty. If anything, our forces in Wehlen have doubled down on their efforts as the Zille handover deadline approaches."

206.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
206.text: "Alternately, we could find a compromise that involves all three of our countries."

208.speaker: Lucita Azaro
208.text: "What troubles me is the specter of Lespia."

209.speaker: Lucita Azaro
209.text: "If Pales claims the field, I am almost certain that our northern neighbors will end up with the rights to it. They could be a presence in our waters for years to come."

210.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
210.text: "That isn't necessarily bad for us. Maybe a compromise can be found that involves all three of our countries."

211.speaker: Player_Romus
211.text: "There is no compromise where Lespia is involved. They'll steamroll over us at the first chance."

215.speaker: Player_Romus
215.text: "I want to leave Lespia out of it. This dispute is between Rizia and Pales."

216.speaker: Player_Romus
216.text: "But then what happens if Morella and their Valgslandian friends get involved? They won't be happy with an ATO member drilling so far south."

217.speaker: Player_Romus
217.text: "That would be one way to get closer to ATO, yes."

218.speaker: Lucita Azaro
218.text: "And that could lead to the kind of consequences I was warning you about earlier, Your Majesty."

219.speaker: Elena Werner
219.text: "I wish it were that simple, Your Majesty. But Pales will have to sell the gas from the Aureus field to someone. And our northern neighbors are the most likely candidates."

220.speaker: Lucita Azaro
220.text: "Are we sure that's what we want, though? Especially with Morella and Valgsland waiting in the wings..."

221.speaker: Elena Werner
221.text: "You know what Lespian Protectionism is like, Laurento. The republic isn't exactly keen on sharing resources."

222.speaker: Narrator
222.text: Laurento had a pained expression on his face.

223.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
223.text: "I still don't think we should give up on the possibility of negotiation."

224.speaker: Player_Romus
224.text: "He ruined his chances at building on our rapport when he sent that ship."

225.speaker: Player_Romus
225.text: "He ruined his chances at reaching an understanding when he sent that ship."

226.speaker: Player_Romus
226.text: "I don't want to come to an understanding. I want to crush his Grand Duchy to smithereens."

228.speaker: Player_Romus
228.text: "For your sake, Mr. Esquibel, I will try to be diplomatic."

229.speaker: Player_Romus
229.text: "I have no idea whether his intentions were sincere. He might still harbor a grudge against Rizia."

230.speaker: Player_Romus
230.text: "That will be hard with Lespia looking over his shoulder. But I will try to be diplomatic."

231.speaker: Player_Romus
231.text: "You're right. If we meet in person, I'm sure I'll be able to get him to back down."

232.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
232.text: "The only way to find out is to talk to him."

233.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
233.text: "You know how much I respected your father. But with you, I see a chance for a new approach."

235.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
235.text: "The ship has not started drilling yet. It could be he doesn't intend for it to do so."

236.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
236.text: "I am sure of it as well."

237.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
237.text: "Shall we discuss our diplomatic options? Are you leaning towards any particular outcome?"

238.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
238.text: "Perhaps we should at least discuss our diplomatic options? Are you leaning towards any particular outcome?"

239.speaker: Player_Romus
239.text: "We don't need a third party. We can settle this between ourselves."

240.speaker: Player_Romus
240.text: "Do you mean asking the Alliance of Nations to arbitrate the dispute?"

241.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
241.text: "Don't forget, Ms. Werner. What we would lose from ceding the field, we might gain from a closer partnership with Pales and Lespia."

242.speaker: Hugo Toras
242.text: "On the other hand, Mr. Esquibel, it will make us look weak. And the foreign powers will jump on the opportunity like vultures."

243.speaker: Hugo Toras
243.text: "Think about how much territory we have relinquished already. How much wealth we have lost because of it."

244.speaker: Hugo Toras
244.text: "I am certain that if we give up this gas field, the Wehzeks will be even more emboldened to keep their grip on Zille."

245.speaker: Player_Romus
245.text: "You're right, Hugo. First Pales, then Zille, then this? We must preserve what's left of our kingdom."

246.speaker: Narrator
246.text: My uncle's hand unconsciously formed a fist.

247.speaker: Player_Romus
247.text: "On the other hand, won't fighting for our rightful part of the field take up resources we should be using to get Zille back?"

248.speaker: Player_Romus
248.text: "What if we're actually wrong about having a claim to the field? Ceding it to Pales would save us a lot of trouble."

249.speaker: Elena Werner
249.text: "You do have a point there, Your Majesty. We would have to allocate our funding very carefully."

250.speaker: Lucita Azaro
250.text: "If we do cede the field, it must be done very carefully. We can't let Duke Reinhart think that his intimidation tactics worked on us."

251.speaker: Elena Werner
251.text: "Unfortunately, arbitration is an expensive and time-consuming process. And there's no guarantee it would end in our favor."

252.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
252.text: "Correct, Your Majesty. AN arbitration is the typical path in disputes like these."

253.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
253.text: "If you can't, though, the Alliance of Nations would be called in to arbitrate."

254.speaker: Player_Romus
254.text: "A third party... like the Rizian military?"

255.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
255.text: "With that said, it's definitely the safest way to avoid a diplomatic incident."

256.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
256.text: "I believe Ms. Werner was referring to the Alliance of Nations. It's usually called on to arbitrate disputes like these."

257.speaker: Elena Werner
257.text: "The value of the gas in the field is high enough that I think it's worth defending our claim for as long as we can."

258.speaker: Player_Romus
258.text: "I don't like the idea any more than you do, Hugo. But my father taught me that sometimes we have to sacrifice part of our kingdom to save the rest of it."

259.speaker: Hugo Toras
259.text: "Up to a point, Your Majesty. What happens when we have nothing left to sacrifice?"

260.speaker: Player_Romus
260.text: "We have Rumburg on our side. I'm sure Queen Beatrice would support us through the arbitration process."

261.speaker: Player_Romus
261.text: "It does sound like the law is on our side. Maybe this is the easiest way forward."

262.speaker: Player_Romus
262.text: "We don't have time to spare. I want that gas *now*."

263.speaker: Player_Romus
263.text: "No, the AN will muddle everything up with its bureaucracy. I want to talk to the Duke man to man."

264.speaker: Elena Werner
264.text: "Even if we were granted part of the field instantly, it would take a while before gas extraction could begin."

265.speaker: Elena Werner
265.text: "But yes, arbitration would take even longer."

266.speaker: Elena Werner
266.text: "On the other hand, if the AN does end up ruling against us, that would be definitive. We would be forced to completely give up our claim."

267.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
267.text: "The weight of GRACE versus that of Lespia and ATO. We would be evenly matched."

268.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
268.text: "I would encourage you to try, Your Majesty."

270.speaker: Narrator
270.text: She spoke slowly, as if thinking out loud.

271.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
271.text: "Are you in your right mind, young lady? The navy? We'd be escalating the situation."

275.speaker: Player_Romus
275.text: "Is there a way we can claim the entire field for Rizia?"

276.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
276.text: "Not without major diplomatic repercussions, I'm afraid."

277.speaker: Elena Werner
277.text: "No matter which maritime boundaries you look at, it's clear that half of the field lies in Palesian territory."

278.speaker: Elena Werner
278.text: "The only way for Rizian Oil and Gas to access the entire field would be for us to purchase the exploration rights from Pales."

279.speaker: Player_Romus
279.text: "That would make our gas extraction dependent on their conditions. No, thanks."

280.speaker: Player_Romus
280.text: "Sounds costlier than I envisioned, but we would certainly reap the rewards. Why don't we pursue that option?"

282.speaker: Lucita Azaro
282.text: "We could, but we have to remember that Lespia is involved."

286.speaker: Lucita Azaro
286.text: "We could, but we have to consider Lespia's potential involvement."

287.speaker: Lucita Azaro
287.text: "We know for a fact that LesPower has designs on the gas field. If we want the rights, we will have to outbid them."

288.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
288.text: "Which may be difficult, considering the shaky state of Rizian-Palesian relations."

289.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
289.text: "And before that, we'd have to convince Duke Reinhart that Rizia is a trustworthy partner."

293.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
293.text: "Which might be possible. Reinhart still seems to trust you more than your father, Your Majesty."

294.speaker: Lucita Azaro
294.text: "If Lespia already has designs on the field, Pales could force us to outbid them for access to it."

295.speaker: Narrator
295.text: I saw a hint of a smile on Lucita's face.

299.speaker: Lucita Azaro
299.text: "I am still not convinced that's the right course of action for us."

300.speaker: Lucita Azaro
300.text: "However, if you insisted on a new campaign against Pales, I would be obliged to provide counsel."

302.speaker: Lucita Azaro
302.text: "I am still not convinced that's the right course of action for us."

306.speaker: Lucita Azaro
306.text: "Although it would make this dispute considerably less complicated."

307.speaker: Lucita Azaro
307.text: "Agreed, Your Majesty. And don't forget about Lespia's involvement."

311.speaker: Lucita Azaro
311.text: "Agreed, Your Majesty. And don't forget about Lespia's potential involvement."

314.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
314.text: "I beg of you to trust your first instincts, Duchess Azaro. Pursuing a path of aggression could delay our access to the gas field for months or even years."

317.speaker: Hugo Toras
317.text: "We have still not decided what to do about the Palesian drillship."

318.speaker: Player_Romus
318.text: "I don't like the idea of it being present in the gas field during our negotiations. But I don't see a way to stop it."

319.speaker: Player_Romus
319.text: "We shouldn't immediately interpret the ship as a provocation. This could all be a misunderstanding."

320.speaker: Player_Romus
320.text: "We have to do *something*, obviously. The Palesians must not be allowed to get away with this."

321.speaker: Lucita Azaro
321.text: "I do, Your Majesty. But my fellow councilors won't like it."

322.speaker: Lucita Azaro
322.text: "I have one idea, Your Majesty. But my fellow councilors won't like it."

323.speaker: Hugo Toras
323.text: "Respectfully, Your Majesty, the Palesians' intentions are crystal clear to me. Even if Duke Reinhart is open to negotiations, he sent this ship to rattle us."

324.speaker: Lucita Azaro
324.text: "My suggestion is to rattle him right back."

325.speaker: Lucita Azaro
325.text: "With His Majesty's blessing... the Rizian navy could surround the field, preventing the drillship from reaching its destination."

327.speaker: Player_Romus
327.text: "'Young lady'? I know you come from a different generation, Mr. Esquibel, but that address was completely out of line."

328.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
328.text: "Excuse me, Your Majesty. But only the impetuousness of youth could be behind such a rash response."

329.speaker: Player_Romus
329.text: "I second that. A military response could have disastrous consequences."

330.speaker: Player_Romus
330.text: "It's not an outlandish suggestion. We've already established that Pales is violating international law."

331.speaker: Elena Werner
331.text: "Actually, my elderly friend, Duchess Azaro may have the right idea."

332.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
332.text: "Tensions with Pales are high enough already. This could bring them to a boiling point."

336.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
336.text: "We were on the verge of reconciling with Pales after all these years. This would shatter our chances."

338.speaker: Elena Werner
338.text: "Of course we shouldn't fire on their ship. But a blockade would keep the gas field clear until you've had a chance to speak with Duke Reinhart."

339.speaker: Elena Werner
339.text: "The Duchess is not talking about sinking the drilling ship, Mr. Esquibel."

340.speaker: Elena Werner
340.text: "A blockade could keep the field clear until His Majesty has had a chance to speak with Duke Reinhart."

342.speaker: Elena Werner
342.text: "If we do end up in arbitration talks, Pales having an established presence in the Aureus field would give them an unwarranted edge."

343.speaker: Player_Romus
343.text: "That settles it, then. I want us to have a fighting chance to claim our rightful part of the field."

344.speaker: Hugo Toras
344.text: "I too am wary of miring ourselves in another conflict."

345.speaker: Player_Romus
345.text: "Even so, the risk of escalation is too high. It doesn't seem worth it."

350.speaker: Player_Romus
350.text: "I am hesitant to interfere. What if ATO retaliates?"

351.speaker: Lucita Azaro
351.text: "There may be LesPower executives on board the ship, but it is flying the Palesian flag. Neither Lespia nor ATO would be allowed to get involved."

352.speaker: Player_Romus
352.text: "Pales and Lespia are literally testing the waters with us. If we let them reach the field, we have already lost it."

353.speaker: Hugo Toras
353.text: "I agree that asserting Rizian sovereignty is of the utmost importance."

354.speaker: Hugo Toras
354.text: "Especially knowing what we know about Lespia's involvement."

358.speaker: Hugo Toras
358.text: "But I am wary of miring ourselves in another conflict. What if the Palesians call our bluff?"

359.speaker: Hugo Toras
359.text: "Yes, sending the navy would help assert Rizian sovereignty, but are we strong enough to defend ourselves should the Palesians call our bluff?"

360.speaker: Lucita Azaro
360.text: "We don't need to worry about that, Your Grace. Our navy is capable of outgunning Pales if need be."

364.speaker: Lucita Azaro
364.text: "That is a concern, Your Grace. We have a capable navy, but we won't be able to outgun Pales if it comes down to that."

365.speaker: Lucita Azaro
365.text: "Still, this is not a decision to take lightly."

366.speaker: Lucita Azaro
366.text: "This is not a decision to take lightly."

367.speaker: Player_Romus
367.text: "I understand the implications. But I fear we have no other choice. We will institute a naval blockade of the gas field immediately." [Order Blockade, +1 Authority]

368.speaker: Player_Romus
368.text: "I agree. And I think we should exercise caution. I will meet with Duke Reinhart before deciding our next steps."

369.speaker: Player_Romus
369.text: "I see through your manipulations, Duchess Azaro, and I will not give in. We will refrain from provoking Pales."

370.speaker: Player_Romus
370.text: "I do not take Duke Reinhart's violation of the law lightly, either. Our navy will show him that Rizia cannot be intimidated." [Order Blockade, +1 Authority]

372.speaker: Narrator
372.text: She clenched her jaw and forced herself to smile.

373.speaker: Lucita Azaro
373.text: "I understand, Your Majesty. Let me know if there's any other way I can support you in your negotiations."

376.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
376.text: "Very good, Your Majesty. I'll get everything in order for your meeting."

380.speaker: Lucita Azaro
380.text: "As you wish, Your Majesty. I'll make the order right away."

381.speaker: Narrator
381.text: Lucita nodded. Laurento and Elena exchanged troubled glances.

383.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
383.text: "This will add a tense background to negotiations, to say the least. But I have faith it will all work out for the best."

384.speaker: Elena Werner
384.text: "That's the spirit, Laurento. I'm sure our ships will only be in place for a few days at most."

385.speaker: Hugo Toras
385.text: "I'll adjourn the meeting so Duchess Azaro may begin preparations. We will inform you of the navy's position prior to your departure for Pales."

386.speaker: Lucita Azaro
386.text: "Our naval forces will be on standby in case you change your mind."

387.speaker: Hugo Toras
387.text: "I pray to St. Wruhec that they will not be needed."

389.speaker: Hugo Toras
389.text: "I'll adjourn the meeting so Mr. Esquibel can begin his preparations. We'll keep you abreast of any changes prior to your departure for Pales."

390.speaker: Player_Romus
390.text: "I hope I don't regret following your advice, Mr. Esquibel."

393.speaker: Player_Romus
393.text: "I hope there are no more unpleasant surprises."

394.speaker: Hugo Toras
394.text: "We'll see to it that there aren't."

395.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
395.text: "I am certain you would have regretted a military response more."

396.speaker: Lucita Azaro
396.text: "Good luck, Your Majesty. I mean that sincerely."

397.speaker: Player_Romus
397.text: "I fully expect a peaceful resolution. This is just a precaution."

398.speaker: Player_Romus
398.text: "I wish I could see the look on Reinhart's face when he finds out about this."

399.speaker: Player_Romus
399.text: "Thank you for the suggestion, Duchess. I knew you could be counted on."

400.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
400.text: "You'll see him very soon, Your Majesty."

401.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
401.text: "No need to justify it, Your Majesty. This is your decision."

402.speaker: Lucita Azaro
402.text: "I'm just doing my job, Your Majesty."

405.speaker: Narrator
405.text: The meeting drew to a close.

406.speaker: Narrator
406.text: I spent a sleepless night in Fort Ales, wondering what would happen when the Rizian navy reached its destination.

410.speaker: Player_Romus
410.text: "They are the ones who are escalating. We cannot simply stay idle. We need a strong response."

414.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
414.text: "Since then, both Rizia and Pales have variously claimed ownership of these waters and the resources therein."
